LanguageData.IcecreamTail_EnabledTip: Disabling this immediately removes all ice cream tail states.
LanguageData.IcecreamTail_AutoLickTip: Replaces a normal eating job with tail licking only when vanilla has found food, the pawn's food level is strictly below the threshold, and a tail is available.
LanguageData.IcecreamTail_Friendly: Allow friendly visitors to lick tails
LanguageData.IcecreamTail_FriendlyTip: When disabled, only your own pawns are considered for automatic tail licking.
LanguageData.IcecreamTail_FoodThreshold: Food threshold for replacing normal meals: {0}
LanguageData.IcecreamTail_MoodTip: Both the eater and the ice dragon receive the appropriate mood memories.
LanguageData.IcecreamTail_RelationshipTip: The eater and the ice dragon gain positive social memories of each other.
LanguageData.IcecreamTail_BuffTip: The eater receives a day-long movement, shooting, and melee buff.
LanguageData.IcecreamTail_HalfVanillaTip: Vanilla buffs last half as long as other ordinary flavors. The duration multiplier above still applies.
LanguageData.IcecreamTail_Hangover: Enable hangover after the fourth round
LanguageData.IcecreamTail_HangoverTip: When the fourth-round buff expires naturally, it causes a one-day hangover. Beer-specific effects cannot be gained during the hangover.
LanguageData.IcecreamTail_CoreRecoveryTip: A more stable ice crystal core makes ice cream tails recover faster.
LanguageData.IcecreamTail_HungerTip: While the tail is forming new ice cream, the ice dragon's hunger rate becomes 110%.
LanguageData.IcecreamTail_TailCombat: Enable ice cream tail combat effects
LanguageData.IcecreamTail_TailCombatTip: An ice dragon with a fully grown ice cream tail deals extra damage and slows enemies.
LanguageData.IcecreamTail_Animation17Tip: Toggle the Getsuga Saiho (CA) animation. Version 1.7 uses my built-in animation framework and no longer requires Melee Animation. Disabling this uses a very simple sequence instead. Turn it off if you prefer to skip the roughly ten-second animation or have performance concerns (probably unnecessary).
LanguageData.IcecreamTail_Animation16Tip: Toggle the Getsuga Saiho (CA) animation, which requires Melee Animation in version 1.6. If disabled or Melee Animation is absent, a very simple sequence is used instead. Turn it off if you prefer to skip the roughly ten-second animation or have performance concerns (probably unnecessary).
LanguageData.IcecreamTail_AnimationUnavailable: Built-in character animation unavailable (using the simplified sequence for this session): {0}
LanguageData.IcecreamTail_LogTailTip: Log tail maturation, recovery, tail loss, and recovery hunger changes in Player.log.
LanguageData.IcecreamTail_LogFaceTip: Log Facial Animation controllers, animation mappings, and playback requests in Player.log.
LanguageData.IcecreamTail_LogAutoTip: Log whether vanilla food searches result in tail licking instead of normal eating.
LanguageData.IcecreamTail_LogEggTip: Log chocolate, fourth-round beer, and frozen-tongue easter eggs in Player.log.
LanguageData.IcecreamTail_DebugCooldown: Show temporary ability cooldown debug button
LanguageData.IcecreamTail_DebugCooldownTip: Show a button on drafted fourth-round Nivarians. It resets only this mod's temporary ability cooldowns.
LanguageData.IcecreamTail_ChocolateEggTip: Wolfeins who lick a chocolate ice cream tail receive about ten minutes of severe food poisoning and a special mood memory.
LanguageData.IcecreamTail_HistoryEgg: Nutmeg stone chronicle text easter egg
LanguageData.IcecreamTail_HistoryEggTip: Nivarians may find little notes from the stone chronicles after eating a nutmeg ice cream tail. Disable this to hide the floating notes~ Who keeps putting them in there?
LanguageData.IcecreamTail_EggSounds: Enable extra easter egg ability sounds
LanguageData.IcecreamTail_EggSoundsTip: When disabled, fourth-round, mint breath, and other easter egg abilities do not play this mod's extra sound effects.
LanguageData.IcecreamTail_WinEggTip: Rolled only when a Nivarian advances from the third to the fourth round. Displays the WIN image and plays a sound when triggered.
LanguageData.IcecreamTail_FrozenEggTip: When disabled, the frozen-tongue easter egg cannot trigger.
LanguageData.IcecreamTail_FrozenTongueChance: Chance of freezing the tongue while licking a tail: {0}%
LanguageData.IcecreamTail_TailDescription: An icy tail that looks delicious, meow~
LanguageData.IcecreamTail_HistoryNote: There's a little note hidden in the ice cream:
LanguageData.IcecreamTail_FrozenTongueMessage: {0}'s tongue froze while tasting {1}'s ice cream tail, meow!
LanguageData.IcecreamTail_ResetCooldownsTip: Reset only the selected pawn's ice cream tail temporary ability cooldowns.
LanguageData.IcecreamTail_BakkaiActive: Super Burst! Burst! Spin! is still in progress.
LanguageData.IcecreamTail_SterilizerActive: Lord Sterilizer is still providing support.
LanguageData.IcecreamTail_NoLanding: No valid landing cell beside the target.
LanguageData.IcecreamTail_TargetMap: Select a hostile target on the same map.
LanguageData.IcecreamTail_TargetDowned: Getsuga Saiho cannot target dead or downed pawns.
LanguageData.IcecreamTail_TargetHostile: Getsuga Saiho can only target hostile pawns.
LanguageData.IcecreamTail_TargetRange: Target is outside Getsuga Saiho's range or line of sight is blocked.
LanguageData.IcecreamTail_TargetBusy: Target is already involved in another Getsuga Saiho.
LanguageData.IcecreamTail_NeedBeer: Only Nivarians in the fourth-round beer state can use this ability.
LanguageData.IcecreamTail_NeedMint: Only Nivarians with the mint ice cream tail buff can use this ability.
LanguageData.IcecreamTail_NeedMatcha: Only Nivarians with the matcha ice cream tail buff can use this ability.
LanguageData.IcecreamTail_HumanlikeOnly: only humanlike pawns can lick tails
LanguageData.IcecreamTail_NoAutoEat: not eligible for automatic eating right now
LanguageData.IcecreamTail_NoAutoTail: no reachable, unreserved mature ice cream tail
